sql: /* Query 4: filter2_agg1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT player.team, MAX(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS max_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE city.state_name = 'Arizona' AND city.area >= 1314.80 GROUP BY player.team

olympic_gold_medals.description: number of Olympic gold medals the player has won (e.g., 3).

team.description: the current NBA team the player belongs to, or the last NBA team the player joined if not currently active (e.g., Los Angeles Lakers).
